Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, Joannes Dominicus Mansi; tomus duodecimus, ab anno DCLXXXVII usque ad annum DCCLXXXVII (facsimile reprint of the Florence 1766 printing)
Creator: J. D. Mansi and others (eds.); facsimile reprint by H. Welter (title page)
Publisher: Florentiae: expensis Antonii Zatta Veneti, 1766 (the original title, read on the page image, leaf n8; the OCR keeps only 'EXPENSIS ANTONII ZATTA VENETI'); reproduction en fac-similé pour H. Welter, Paris et Leipzig (the facsimile's own leaf)
Publication Date: 1901 (the facsimile's own title leaf, read on the page image of the scan (leaf n7: '1901'); the OCR prints the year as 'IgoI' at line 171)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1901); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0012vari, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (3,632,784) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1901, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair, with long s read as f; the Greek columns are garbled (read as Latin letters). Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Councils of 687-787. The Second Council of Nicaea (787) begins at about OCR line 99123 ('SANCTA SYNODUS NICAENA SECUNDA GENERALIS') and runs to the end of the volume: sessions I to III. 'FINIS TOMI DECIMI SECUNDI' at about 118557. The council continues in tomus XIII.
